entries.name: System Program
entries.description: The native Solana program that creates accounts, allocates account data, assigns ownership, and transfers SOL.

entries.name: SPL Token Program
entries.description: The standard Solana Program Library program implementing minting, transferring, and burning of fungible and non-fungible SPL tokens.

entries.name: Token-2022 Program (Token Extensions)
entries.description: A superset of the original SPL Token Program adding optional extensions such as transfer fees, confidential transfers, and metadata.

entries.name: Associated Token Account Program
entries.description: Deterministically derives and creates a canonical token account address for a given wallet and mint pair.

entries.name: Memo Program
entries.description: Validates and logs an arbitrary UTF-8 memo string attached to a transaction, optionally verifying signer accounts.

entries.name: Metaplex Token Metadata Program
entries.description: Attaches and manages metadata (name, symbol, image, description) for fungible and non-fungible SPL tokens.

entries.name: Jupiter Aggregator v6
entries.description: Routes and executes token swaps across multiple Solana DEXs to find the best execution price.

entries.name: Raydium AMM v4 (Liquidity Pool V4)
entries.description: Raydium's original constant-product AMM integrated with the OpenBook central limit order book.

entries.name: Raydium CLMM (Concentrated Liquidity)
entries.description: Raydium's concentrated liquidity market maker allowing liquidity providers to set custom price ranges.

entries.name: Raydium CPMM (CP-Swap)
entries.description: Raydium's constant-product AMM supporting Token-2022 without requiring an OpenBook market ID.

entries.name: Orca Whirlpool Program
entries.description: Orca's concentrated liquidity AMM program for token swaps and liquidity provision.

entries.name: Meteora DLMM Program
entries.description: Meteora's Dynamic Liquidity Market Maker, a bin-based concentrated liquidity AMM.

entries.name: Meteora Dynamic AMM v2 (DAMM v2)
entries.description: Meteora's current-generation constant-product/dynamic-fee AMM pool program, distinct from DLMM.

entries.name: Pump.fun Program
entries.description: Bonding-curve token launchpad that mints and manages newly created meme tokens until they graduate to a liquidity pool.

entries.name: PumpSwap AMM Program
entries.description: Pump.fun's own AMM/DEX that receives liquidity migrated from graduated bonding-curve tokens.

entries.name: Tensor Marketplace Program
entries.description: Tensor's core NFT marketplace program facilitating permissionless listing and trading of NFTs.

entries.name: Magic Eden v2 Marketplace Program (M2)
entries.description: The core Magic Eden v2 (M2) contract powering NFT listing, bidding, and sale execution.

entries.name: Marinade Finance Liquid Staking Program
entries.description: Marinade's main liquid staking program that mints/burns mSOL against staked SOL.

entries.name: Jito Tip Payment Program
entries.description: Jito's mainnet tip payment program that routes MEV tips from searchers/users to block-producing validators.

entries.name: Kamino Lending Program (KLend)
entries.description: Kamino's lending protocol program managing collateralized borrow/lend markets.

entries.name: marginfi v2 Program
entries.description: marginfi's v2 program for decentralized borrowing and lending against SOL, LSTs, and other collateral.

entries.name: Solend (Save)
entries.description: A decentralized algorithmic lending and borrowing protocol on Solana, rebranded to Save.

entries.name: Drift Protocol V2
entries.description: An open-source Solana exchange offering perpetual futures, spot trading, and lending/borrowing markets.

entries.name: Phoenix
entries.description: A fully on-chain central limit order book DEX built by Ellipsis Labs with atomic trade settlement.

entries.name: OpenBook V2
entries.description: A community-maintained, fully on-chain central limit order book DEX, the v2 successor to the original Serum-fork OpenBook program.

entries.name: Lifinity Swap V2
entries.description: An oracle-based proactive/delta-neutral market maker AMM designed to improve capital efficiency and reduce impermanent loss.

entries.name: Wormhole Core Bridge
entries.description: The core messaging program on Solana that verifies and emits cross-chain messages (VAAs) for the Wormhole protocol.

entries.name: deBridge Gate
entries.description: The DeBridgeGate program enabling decentralized cross-chain transfers of arbitrary messages and value.

entries.name: Sanctum Unstake
entries.description: Sanctum's unstake program providing instant liquidity for unstaking native Solana stake accounts without waiting for a cooldown epoch.

entries.name: Squads Multisig v4
entries.description: The Squads Protocol v4 multisig program providing multi-signature wallet functionality with time locks, spending limits, and roles.

entries.name: Meteora Dynamic AMM (Pools Program v1)
entries.description: Constant-product AMM pools with integrated lending yield for LPs; high daily volume.

entries.name: Meteora Dynamic Vault
entries.description: Yield-vault layer backing Meteora AMM pools; vault-owned token accounts can hold very large balances.

entries.name: Meteora Alpha Vault
entries.description: Anti-bot/anti-snipe token-launch vault that pools deposits before releasing tokens at launch.

entries.name: Orca Token Swap V2 (legacy)
entries.description: Orca's legacy constant-product swap program (pre-Whirlpool); superseded but still holds legacy pools.

entries.name: Saros AMM (V1)
entries.description: Saros Finance's core constant-product AMM/swap program.

entries.name: Saros DLMM
entries.description: Saros Finance's concentrated-liquidity (DLMM) program.

entries.name: FluxBeam
entries.description: DEX/AMM specializing in Token-2022 (Token Extensions) swaps and pools.

entries.name: Stabble Stable Swap
entries.description: Stabble's stable-asset AMM pool program.

entries.name: GooseFX GAMMA
entries.description: GooseFX's dynamic-fee AMM for spot token swaps.

entries.name: Crema Finance CLMM
entries.description: Uniswap-v3-style concentrated-liquidity AMM; suffered an $8.78M exploit in July 2022, relaunched since.

entries.name: Invariant
entries.description: Concentrated-liquidity AMM DEX on Solana.

entries.name: Cropper Finance AMM
entries.description: Cropper Finance's permissionless AMM/swap program.

entries.name: Saber Stable Swap
entries.description: StableSwap curve AMM for pegged assets/LSTs; team wound down active development around 2022, contract still live.

entries.name: Mercurial Stable Swap (legacy)
entries.description: Legacy stable-swap AMM from Mercurial Finance, the project that rebranded to Meteora in December 2022.

entries.name: Perena Numeraire
entries.description: Multi-asset bounded stable-swap program for stablecoin liquidity.

entries.name: LaunchLab
entries.description: Raydium's bonding-curve token launch program; also underlies LetsBonk.fun via a platform-config PDA.

entries.name: Dynamic Bonding Curve (DBC)
entries.description: Meteora's customizable bonding-curve launch program; underlies Believe, Jupiter Studio, and Bags.fm token launches before graduation to Meteora DAMM v2.

entries.name: Token Launchpad (Moonshot / Moonit)
entries.description: DEX Screener's bonding-curve memecoin launchpad program, now rebranded Moonit.

entries.name: Candy Machine Core v3
entries.description: Metaplex's current-generation NFT collection minting/distribution program.

entries.name: Candy Guard
entries.description: Access-control companion program for Candy Machine v3 (allowlists, payment/bot-tax guards).

entries.name: Streamflow Protocol
entries.description: Token vesting/streaming-payments program, commonly used by launchpads and teams to lock creator allocations.

entries.name: Streamflow Launchpad
entries.description: Streamflow's own token-launchpad product (separate from its vesting program); newer, limited track record.

entries.name: Heaven AMM
entries.description: Combined launchpad and AMM: every token gets a live liquidity pool with a virtual-SOL floor at creation, no bonding-curve migration step.

entries.name: Bags Fee Share V2
entries.description: Current fee-configuration/claiming program for Bags.fm creator royalties (Bags' token launches run through Meteora DBC).

entries.name: Adrena Protocol
entries.description: Perpetuals leverage-trading exchange on Solana supporting BTC/SOL/BONK with a pool-to-peer liquidity model.

entries.name: Flash Trade (Perpetuals)
entries.description: Asset-backed perpetuals and spot leverage-trading exchange on Solana with Pyth-based pricing.

entries.name: Jupiter Perpetuals
entries.description: LP-to-trader perpetuals exchange (SOL/BTC/ETH, up to 100x) that is part of the Jupiter DeFi suite.

entries.name: Mango Markets v4
entries.description: Cross-margin spot/lending and perpetuals trading program (rewrite that replaced Mango v3 after its 2022 exploit).

entries.name: Pyth Price Feed Program
entries.description: Core program that owns all individual Pyth price-feed accounts on Solana mainnet.

entries.name: Switchboard Oracle Program (V2)
entries.description: Core Switchboard V2 program owning oracle aggregator/queue accounts on Solana mainnet.

entries.name: Parcl v3
entries.description: Perpetuals exchange for trading real-estate price index synthetics on Solana.

entries.name: Chainlink Data Feeds (OCR2 Program)
entries.description: Program that owns Chainlink OCR2 price-feed accounts consumed on-chain on Solana mainnet.

entries.name: Loopscale
entries.description: Order-book-style fixed-rate lending/borrowing protocol on Solana; suffered a roughly $5.8M exploit in 2025.
